plan.h: Done: rough cut 4, from your round-9 picks and notes
items: Music: your suspense strings (basses from below, take 2) under the whole cut, slowed slightly to fit; a strings stab on every scare (door, peek, shelf drop, the shelf hand, the mirror, the freezer swoop), the strings dipping under each.
Shelf: you see 50p first; the burnt hand comes down over the card and when it lifts away it says £5.
Freezer: you see £5 and 10p first; the hand swoops across like a magic trick and as it passes they snap to £50 and 10p crossed out for £12.
Prices are drawn in the edit (blank cards in Flow). The subtle VHS finish on every shot; the card and logo stay clean.
The swoop passes just above the freezer cards (its shadow crosses them), so the prices flip as it passes rather than under the palm.
The £1 step is gone: one pass of the hand, one change.
Not in Premiere yet: say "build it in Premiere" when it's right.
